author: David Mcdaniel
text: Darrell did a great job. Even though there was unforeseen circumstances (weather, the lay of the waterline) until they started digging Darrell handled it professionally and got the job done in good time. Darrell is very knowledgeable in his profession and lets you know step by step what the job at hand needs to be done and how it should be done more efficient and cost-effective.  Darrell is willing to go the extra mile when things unforeseen arise. Him and his crew were very nice and relatable which helps to keep a customer comfortable and at ease. Even after the job at hand was done he took the time to follow up with a call to make sure things were good.  I highly recommend him and his company and his crew and will be using him again if needed.

author: jeff k
text: Darrell came in on emergency notice when our house went under contract and our inspection was unable to complete a sewer scope. We had no sewer drain clean out trap to stick a camera in. he came in same day and installed a valve for the sewer inspectors to come back the next day. He was able to do this in about 20 minutes and still maintain the quality. It was actually quite impressive. I can't thank him enough for his quick response and his work as it really helped us out with our inspection.

author: Janice Belcher
text: If it were possible to rate negative stars, I would. It has been almost a year since Darryl dugout our driveway to get to our sewer. My husband paid him in full with Darryl’s promise that he would repair the driveway he wrecked.  Now as I am still trying to get him to finish the job he was paid for he refuses to answer his phone or respond to my messages.   I would not recommend this company to anyone ever.

author: Loraine Knipp
text: I wouldn’t recommend this company for any type of work. He was 2 1/2 hours late the first appointment and 2 hours late the second appointment. He cut a hole in the concrete to repair a sewer pipe. A week had passed and I had to call him.  For that week I was smelling sewer gases, which was quite unhealthy. He said that’s the first I heard of you smelling the gases?!?! Sure, an open sewer in my basement for a whole week! He did not finish the repair, since he was unreliable and not sure he knew what he was even doing? I had to pay another company to finish what he started, besides paying him for his INCOMPLETE work. If I could put negative stars I would!

author: Amy Vera
text:
Five Stars! Darrell Went Above and Beyond!

I can’t recommend Darrell enough! He came out to hydro jet our sewer line and did an absolutely outstanding job. What really impressed me was his dedication—he stayed way longer than originally scheduled just to make sure everything was done right. When he realized he needed a some additional power to finish the job properly, he didn’t cut corners—he actually went all the way back to his shop to get what he needed and came right back to finish the work. That kind of commitment and professionalism is so rare these days. If you need someone who truly cares about doing the job right, Darrell is your guy! Darrell if we run into more issues in the future at our new home you will be my first call. Thank you again for your hard work.
